import sys,json
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
sys.path.insert(0,'/Users/bobsingor/GitHub/cloudpdf-platform/oss/embedpdf/packages/engine/main/test/fixtures/signature-compat')
from generate import reader,raw_body
from generate_v2 import page_of
from verify_v3 import changed_keys
root=Path('/tmp/epdf-weak-nm-probes/pdfs')
m=json.loads((root/'manifest.json').read_text())
for case in m['cases']:
 data=(root/case['file']).read_bytes(); r=reader(data)
 base=(root/f"{case['profile']}-{case['layout']}-control.pdf").read_bytes(); before=reader(base)
 squares=[a.get_object() for a in page_of(r)['/Annots'] if a.get_object().get('/Subtype')=='/Square']
 expected=['weak-0','weak-2','weak-3'] if case['action'].startswith('delete') else ['weak-3','weak-0','weak-1','weak-2'] if case['action'].startswith('reorder') else ['weak-0','weak-1','weak-2','weak-3']
 assert [str(a['/Contents']) for a in squares]==expected, case['id']
 previous={str(a.get_object()['/Contents']):a.get_object() for a in page_of(before)['/Annots'] if a.get_object().get('/Subtype')=='/Square'}
 for square in squares:
  name=str(square['/Contents']); ap=square['/AP'].raw_get('/N')
  assert raw_body(data,ap.idnum)==raw_body(base,ap.idnum), case['id']
  assert changed_keys(previous[name],square)==({'/NM'} if 'names' in case['action'] and not int(square.get('/F',0))&128 else set())
print('72 independent order, survivor-key, and appearance-byte checks passed.')
